title: Orientation and safety
summary: What Linux is, how to read a prompt, how to type and cancel commands, and which commands can destroy data. Six short lessons that make everything afterwards make sense.
outcomes: Explain the difference between the kernel, a distribution, a shell and a terminal
Read a shell prompt and say who you are, where you are and whether you are root
Edit a command line and recall an earlier command without retyping it
Cancel a running command and close input deliberately
Name the commands that can destroy data and say what makes each one dangerous
